name: pharma-delivery
description: Sistema empresarial de trazabilidad farmacéutica, logística y entregas

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web,mobile -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @pharma/backend" "npm run dev -w @pharma/web-admin" "npm run dev -w @pharma/mobile-expo"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @pharma/types && npm run build -w @pharma/utils && npm run build -w @pharma/api-client
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @pharma/web-admin
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pharma/types && npm run build -w @pharma/utils && npm run build -w @pharma/api-client && npm run build -w @pharma/backend && npm run build -w @pharma/web-admin
scripts.db:seed: npm run db:generate && npm run db:seed -w @pharma/backend
